title: States and transitions
summary: IDLE, SPIN_UP, SHOOT, and the rules between them.

steps.title: The machine
steps.say: The shooter is always in exactly one state. It can't jump straight to SHOOT: it has to spin up first.

board.code:
wants SHOOT           at speed
  IDLE ------------> SPIN_UP ---------> SHOOT
   ^                   ^                  |
   |    lets go        |    slows down    |
   +-------------------+------------------+

marks.label: can't feed until it's at speed

steps.title: Transitions
steps.say: The driver only says what they **want**. The subsystem decides where it's allowed to be.

marks.label: a yes/no method reads like English

steps.title: Open ShooterSubsystem.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find handleStateTransition
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+F**, search for `handleStateTransition`, and write the rules from the comment above it.
